description: Validation schema for PISA codebook extracted JSON files. The canonical root key is 'codebook_entries' (matching llamaconfig.json). Legacy files using 'Variables' are also accepted.

oneOf.description: Canonical format: root key 'codebook_entries', matching llamaconfig.json schema.
Legacy batch format: root key 'Variables' (accepted for backward compatibility).

variable_array.description: A list of variable definitions from the questionnaire codebook.

variable_key.description: The unique identifier or short code for the variable (e.g., 'COUNTRY', 'SC01Q01').

format_specifier.description: The format specifier from the codebook (e.g., '(A3)', 'F1', 'F8.3').

variable_key_value.description: A list of code-to-label mappings, or null if the variable is continuous.

variable_description.description: A human-readable description of the variable.
